entries.name: Tidefall

counterPressure.note: It threshes ground, not flesh. Whatever edge the crowbar once had went into prying the world open instead — nothing that comes out swinging is coming from this.

entries.flavor: It was built for opening doors that were never meant to open. Now it opens the ground itself, and the ground it leaves behind never grows anything again — just more room for the tide behind it to fill.

entries.name: Furnace of the Shadow

counterPressure.note: The plating that should ring the wearer's ribs went instead toward counting coin. Anything that leans on this cage for raw endurance leans on far less than the bars suggest.

entries.flavor: It burns nothing you can see. Whatever passes through its bars leaves something behind — a coin, a scrap, a share of what the swarm stripped on the way past — and the furnace never once asks whose it was.

entries.name: Umbral Shell

counterPressure.note: The shell answers only once its wearer is already bleeding. A first hit finds nothing waiting to bounce back — the dark has to be provoked before it bites.

entries.flavor: Netting meant to catch scrap now catches blows instead, and returns every one of them with the weight of however many are pressed in behind it. Nobody who strikes it learns how many that was.

entries.name: Dogtag of the Throng

counterPressure.note: It only ever answers for the one wearing it. Whatever it steals back off a hit never reaches anyone standing beside them, and the tag itself carries barely a name's weight of protection on its own.

entries.flavor: A name written in someone else's hand, on a tag stamped from the same mould as ten thousand others. Wear it and the throng does not treat you as one of the ten thousand — it treats you as all of them, briefly, whenever it costs you blood to be.

entries.name: Facelessmark

counterPressure.note: The mark only takes on whatever is close enough to look back. Fall behind the front line and the gaze finds nothing worth confusing.

entries.flavor: The cloth hides nothing of what looks back through it, because there was never a face under there worth hiding. Whatever meets that gap in the strips forgets, for a moment, which side of the line it was standing on.

entries.name: Creepmass

counterPressure.note: Every stride that clears the ground beneath it borrows a little from the strength that should be landing in the swing. A tread built to walk through graves has less left over for a fight.

entries.flavor: Stamped out in bulk for someone's army, it was never meant to carry a name. Every plate it presses into the dirt opens the ground a little further, until the soil remembers how many have walked here and gives the rest of them room.

entries.name: Jerrycan of the Nightfall

counterPressure.note: What drips from it is meant for spending, not for fighting. Barely enough rot rides along to be called a threat at all — the real yield is whatever the wearer cashes in afterward.

entries.flavor: The metal does not give, but whatever is sealed inside keeps working anyway, souring by the hour until sundown, when it is worth the most to whoever is still carrying it. Nobody has asked what it was before it was this.

entries.name: Klaxon of the Hive

counterPressure.note: Sound it and the hive answers for you. The horn itself carries almost nothing extra for the one still holding it once the call has gone out.

entries.flavor: Amplified past anything it was built to carry, its one note opens paths beneath the ground before it even finishes ringing. Whoever falls holding it does not stop the call — the hive was never listening for a single voice.
